namedVariations.name: Ornn + Jarvan IV engage · Shopify Rebellion
namedVariations.note: Same Yunara + Lulu bot lane, but Ornn and Jarvan IV start fights in front of it instead of K'Sante and Anivia holding space, which covers the main comp's missing on-demand engage. Locke trades Anivia's zone control for close-range damage and costs waveclear. FlyQuest's Ornn, Nocturne and Syndra lineup plays the same way: Ornn starts, Syndra and Yunara deal damage from behind.

namedVariations.name: Jax + Aphelios · LGD Gaming
namedVariations.note: Keeps the plan: Skarner starts, Jax and Locke go in with him, Karma speeds the dive. Tradeoffs: Sivir's team-wide speed-up is gone, Jax is a side-lane diver rather than a second frontliner beside Skarner, and Aphelios needs items, so the comp gives up its early edge and leans later.

held.name: Front-to-back + Split · Yunara
